Supplier notes from the tasting week

Flour: Hartmann mill, organic T65, 0.92 per kilo at 200 kg a month; deliveries Tuesday. Their T80 was too coarse for the croissant dough.

Butter: Val d'Or 84% fat, 6.10 per kilo; Lescure is nicer but 8.40 and the difference did not show in the bake.

Coffee: Northwind roasters, house blend at 18 per kilo, they lend a grinder if we take 15 kilos a month. Decision: Northwind for the opening, revisit in six months.
